fields.Name: IT22 - User Routines Dispatcher
fields.Description: Live, deterministic proof of the User Routines feature (P1.5): the entity servers + the UserRoutineDispatcherDriver end to end (no LLM calls — the executable fixture targets the pure-computation 'Calculate Expression' core Action). UR1-UR5 exercise MJUserRoutineEntityServer NextRunAt/StartAt/claim/invalid-cron/missing-target rules; UR6-UR8 the recipient User-xor-Email exclusivity; UR9 due-evaluation + the SQL prefilter agreeing on window edges; UR10-UR14 a full dispatcher pass (seed-not-run, claim-before-run, run linkage + ResultHash, LastRun* rollup, in-app notify, OnChange no-renotify, cascade delete); UR15-UR16 EnsureRoutineConversation (hidden Application-scoped conversation + idempotency). The bundle creates + tears down every routine/recipient/run/notification/conversation it makes.

ExpectedOutcomes.summary: Entity-server rules enforced; due-evaluation matches the SQL prefilter; a full dispatcher pass runs, links, rolls up, notifies (Always) / suppresses (OnChange), and cascade-deletes; routine conversations are hidden + idempotent.
